Relatives of war criminal grabbed her land, Birangana says
2022-02-06T16:24:36+06:00 | Star Digital Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/crime-justice/news/relatives-war-criminal-grabbed-her-land-birangana-says-2955666

Relatives of a war criminal allegedly grabbed land of Birangana Jamina Begum in Patuakhali.

Yesterday evening, at a press conference in Patuakhali Press Club, Jamina Begum alleged that relatives of war criminal Abdul Gani Talukder's nephew Abdul Latif Talukder and his sons -- Sohag Talukder, and Atik Talukder -- forcefully grabbed her family's land.

Jamina's son Sujal Talukder and other family members were present at the conference.

In a written statement, Jamina said, in 2019, International Crimes Tribunal sentenced Abdul Gani Talukder to death in connection with a case filed over torturing her during the Liberation War.

In 2017, when she gave testimony at the court against Abdul Gani, she was given threats including grabbing the land of her house in Durgapur village at Itbaria union under Sadar upazila.

The grabbers, during a local salish (arbitration), pledged to return her one-acre land but did not do so yet. Now they have been threatening her, demanding that she leave the village, she said.

Jamina said that due to the threats, she has now been living at the house of her daughter's father-in-law.

The Daily Star tried several times to contact accused Abdul Latif and his sons but they could not be reached.

Patuakhali Superintendent of Police Md Shahidullah said that action would be taken if any complaint is received.
